direct_hash_name_path_rule: Exactly one external location must be supported inside candidate-local structured records by a direct hash, the same clean function name, and a corroborating path suffix.
equivalent_source_body_cluster_rule: If multiple strong external locations remain, they may be accepted as one authoritative source-body cluster only when all locations have the same function name, identical AST fingerprint, and identical dedented normalized source fingerprint. All locations must remain recorded.
location_claim_rule: A source-body-cluster resolution does not claim that one physical source location is uniquely identified.
unique_direct_hash_name_rule: Exactly one external location must be supported by candidate-local direct-hash plus clean-name evidence.
